title: Product Testing — Request a Quotation
purpose: Create a product testing job and get a quotation from a laboratory.
meta: 1 Product Info → 2 Requirements → 3 Provider Selection → 4 Done
overview: **Product Info** — add an existing product or create a new one.
**Requirements** — set the export market, test items, quality requirements and service details.
**Provider Selection** — choose Connected Provider, ICW or TicMart, then [[btn:Submit]].
**Done** — the Order details page opens. Track the job there or in the Product Testing list.

body: In the left menu, open **Product Testing**. The page shows charts of job status, service provider and test results, and the list of all jobs. Click [[btn:Create Job]] above the list.

body.alt: Product Testing list page with the Create Job button
body.caption: Product Testing list — Create Job is at the top right of the job list.

body: The **Request Quotations** wizard opens. Add the products for this testing order:

list: [[ghost:+ Existing Products]] picks from your Product Management list.
[[ghost:+ Add Products]] creates a new product here.

body.caption: Step 1 starts empty. Next stays disabled until a product is added.

body: In the **Select Product(s)** pop-up, search by product name or ID, click [[ghost:Select]] on each product you need, then click [[btn:Confirm]]. You can select more than one product.

body.alt: Select Product(s) pop-up with one product selected
body.caption: A selected product shows a blue “✓ Selected” button.

body: Check the product details. You can change **Item name on report** and **Item no. on report**, which are printed on the test report. Click **Add PO Information** to link a purchase order (optional). Then click [[btn:Next]].

body.caption: Use Remove to drop a product, or Edit product profile to update it.

list: **Export Market** — where the product will be sold (required).
**Test Item** (optional) — choose a country, then search for test items or citations.
**Quality Requirement** — Create New Requirements, Add Existing Requirements, or Import Requirement Template.
**Remarks** and **Attachment** (optional) — special instructions and reference files.

body.alt: Step 2 Test Requirements with Export Market filled
body.caption: Export Market filled in.

list: **Service Level** — Regular, Express or Shuttle / Emergency.
**Country of Origin** — where the product is made (you can pick more than one).
**Intended Usage** — General product, Adult product, Children product or Toys.

body: When all required fields are filled, [[btn:Next]] turns blue. Click it.

body.caption: Additional Information filled — Next is now enabled.

body: Choose who should quote this job. You can tick more than one:

table: You already work with a lab that is connected to your QMAS account.
You want ICW to find a lab. Pick a preferred lab, or leave “No Preference”.
You want quotations from labs in the TicMart marketplace.

body.alt: Step 3 Provider Selection with ICW ticked
body.caption: ICW ticked with “No Preference”. Click Submit to send the request.

body: After you click [[btn:Submit]], QMAS shows “Product testing created successfully” and opens the **Order details** page. Your job has a new order number (for example 260008342) and starts as **Under Review**.

list: **Product Testing Requirements**, **Products**, **Supplier**, **PO** and **Test Plan** tabs show what you submitted.
**Quotations** on the right shows lab quotes when they arrive.
The tabs below (Quotes, Failure Records, Reports, Attachments, Invoices, Tag, Activity Log, Message Board) follow the job until the report is ready.

body.caption: The new order opens with status Under Review. You can find it again in the Product Testing list.

tips: Items marked **(optional)** can be skipped. Next stays grey until every required field on the step is filled. A field you leave empty turns red with a message, for example “Country of origin is required”.

tips.alt: Country of Origin field showing required error
tips.caption: Required field left empty.

tips: Item name and item no. on report are what the lab prints on the test report. Check them before you continue.
To leave the wizard, click **✕** at the top right.
